node.statement: One global exterior coefficient budget. The exterior fibers satisfy sum_{Q in Ext}|d_Q| <= t(1+(2+t)/A). Every Q in Ext is nonactor, hence c_Q=0 by the root's zero-top hypothesis. From d_Q,e_Q and p_f=p_v-A(p_z-p_v)+t(p_o-p_v), for every fiber Q one has P_z(Q)=c_Q+d_Q, P_o(Q)=c_Q+e_Q, and P_f(Q)=c_Q-Ad_Q+te_Q. Split Ext into Ext_-:={Q:d_Q<0} and Ext_+:={Q:d_Q>=0}, and let S_-,S_+ be the corresponding unions of original coordinate indices. On S_-, c_Q=0 and the row-z lower subset bound from node 1.1.1 gives -sum_{Ext_-}|d_Q|=P_z(S_-)>=-t, hence sum_{Ext_-}|d_Q|<=t. Put D_+:=sum_{Ext_+}d_Q>=0 and E_+:=sum_{Ext_+}e_Q. On S_+, the row-f lower and row-o upper subset bounds give -AD_++tE_+=P_f(S_+)>=-t and E_+=P_o(S_+)<=1+t. Therefore AD_+<=t(E_++1)<=t(2+t), so sum_{Ext_+}|d_Q|=D_+<=t(2+t)/A. Adding the two sign-union bounds proves the displayed budget; no factor depending on the number of fibers occurs.
